diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 1.7 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: VEML6035 datasheet (doc 84889) features: 'Supply voltage range VDD: 1.7 V to 3.6 V'; recommended operating table: 'Supply voltage VDD 1.7 (min) 1.8 (typ) 3.6 (max) V'. The Ambient 11 Click schematic v100 shows the mikroBUS +3.3V pin (VCC) wired directly to U1 VEML6035 pin 6 VDD with only C1 10uF / C2 0.1uF decoupling and no regulator, so the 3V3 pin's valid range is the chip's 1.7-3.6 V. The second reading's 3.3 V is the board's nominal mikroBUS rail, not a limit; the part already says 'normally 3.3 V ... never 5 V'.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 3.6 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: VEML6035 datasheet: recommended operating 'Supply voltage VDD ... 3.6 V' max (absolute maximum 'Supply voltage VDD 0 ... 4 V'). Ambient 11 Click schematic: +3.3V connects straight to VDD (no LDO, 5V pin unconnected), so 3.6 V is the true maximum at the 3V3 pin; 3.3 V is merely the nominal mikroBUS supply.
